message.content: A great picnic spot in Miami is **South Pointe Park**. It’s located right on the waterfront at the southern tip of Miami Beach, offering wide open lawns, plenty of shade from mature trees, and a beautiful view of the ocean and cruise ships. The park has picnic tables, a playground, and easy access to the beach, making it perfect for a relaxed day out. Enjoy your picnic!
